purpose: Falsifiable public research questions anchored to declared source-register identifiers. Every entry in source_refs must name a source that a register in this repository actually declares, so a question cannot cite a literature impression. An empty list is the correct resting state.
cannot_support: A registered question is not a finding, a result, or evidence of anything.
Registration does not establish feasibility, data access, licensing, or statistical power.
Nothing here supports a claim about any individual, family, or maintainer.
